purpose: Advance Sprint S1.3 by freezing the whole-pack short-duration current requirement from the vehicle-level 1.6 T/W propulsion point while keeping exact cell/topology/mechanical implementation open.

change_control.rule: PB-06 inherits PB-05 unless a PB-06 decision explicitly supersedes an inherited value. Any later change to a PB-06 frozen value requires PB-07 or an explicitly linked engineering change record; no silent overwrite is allowed.

summary: X8 coaxial / eight independent propulsion channels
normal static thrust-to-weight >=1.6 at max design MTOW
18S / >=5.0 kWh gross rated pack energy / 75.6 V full charge / <=80 V outer input ceiling
54.0 V minimum loaded bus for full rated power
>=10 min nominal mission target with 20% gross-energy reserve
>=70 A continuous and >=200 A for >=3 s per-ESC DC capability
>=4.8 kW continuous and >=11.5 kW short-duration per-ESC input capability
>=125 A RMS continuous phase current, >=265 A RMS for >=3 s and >=375 A instantaneous phase peak
power-up/reset DISARMED and no automatic re-arm after fault

new_frozen_decisions.rationale: The frozen 1.6 T/W vehicle sizing point requires 42.353 kgf isolated-equivalent thrust per propulsion channel. Interpolation of current Hobbywing X13 G2 69 V + MFP 56x20 manufacturer data gives about 6.264 kW input per channel at this thrust, or about 50.11 kW for eight channels. At the frozen 54.0 V full-rated-power floor this is about 928 A ideal pack current. Applying 10% design allowance gives about 1021 A; requirement rounded upward to >=1050 A for >=3 s.

pack_architecture_direction.electrical_structure: single 18S flight pack with internal service segmentation preferred for prototype study
pack_architecture_direction.reason: 500 A continuous / 1050 A short-duration current makes unnecessary external series connectors undesirable because each would carry full pack current.

candidate_cell_disposition.primary_qualification_candidate: Molicel INR-21700-P50B in an 18S16P calculation topology
candidate_cell_disposition.mass_optimization_candidate: Molicel INR-21700-P60B in an 18S14P calculation topology
candidate_cell_disposition.mature_alternate: Molicel INR-21700-P45B in an 18S18P calculation topology
candidate_cell_disposition.peak_current_note: At 1050 A the arithmetic current per cell is about 65.6 A for P50B 16P, 75.0 A for P60B 14P and 58.3 A for P45B 18P. These values do not qualify any topology; SOC/temperature/SOH/current-sharing and pack thermal evidence remain mandatory.

remaining_s1_critical_open_items: exact battery cell/pouch MPN, P-count, complete pack mass and service segmentation
low-SOC/cold/aged sag correlation and hard BMS cutoff behavior
peak-capable SOC/temperature/SOH envelope for >=1050 A / >=3 s
PWM frequency/current ripple final closure after exact motor inductance evidence
exact 150 V MOSFET MPN and parallel count
current-sense implementation, DC-link, precharge and thermal architecture
anti_hallucination_rule: PB-06 peak current is a controlled vehicle-level sizing requirement derived from frozen thrust targets and manufacturer propulsion data. It is not a measured pack capability, cell qualification, thermal result or flight result.
